cues.title: Introducing Aloha
cues.note: [Let the true-story joke turn into the title.]

cues.title: Meet Cio
cues.note: Meet Cio. A C-arm on its team’s phone. It has been left on read.

cues.title: Patch overdue
cues.note: Patch due. Subtle, isn’t it?

cues.title: A new personality
cues.note: Updated. Connected. An entirely new personality.

cues.title: Someone cares
cues.note: The joke does a serious job. Somebody feels responsible.

cues.title: Need becomes priority
cues.note: The mood tells us who needs care. Hospital data tells us when.

cues.title: Now
cues.note: [Silence. The stage turns dark.]

cues.title: An actual day of care
cues.note: This is the hard part: finding the right moment.

cues.title: The day changes
cues.note: A case is cancelled. An opportunity opens.

cues.title: Find and challenge
cues.note: Our working rule core checks cases, backup and available people. The scorer weighs emergency demand and overruns.

cues.title: The golden window
cues.note: The window is a result, not a time we made up first.

cues.title: A human publishes
cues.note: Medical physics reviews the proposal and publishes it.

cues.title: One small request
cues.note: Lena gets one request: Cio needs a hand.

cues.title: Not today
cues.note: Not today? No guilt. Ask the circle.

cues.title: The circle
cues.note: Nobody can make the trip.

cues.title: Help arrives
cues.note: Send the invisible helper.

cues.title: Check
cues.note: In our mission demo, it checks what it needs before leaving.

cues.title: Find
cues.note: Finds the machine where it actually is.

cues.title: Connect
cues.note: Then the proposed dock supplies power and approved data.

cues.title: Ready to ask
cues.note: Checks first. A failed check stops the request.

cues.title: Lena gets the decision
cues.note: Lena couldn’t make the trip. She can still review the request.

cues.title: Time and surroundings
cues.note: The right time. Clear surroundings.

cues.title: A human starts
cues.note: A human starts every update.

cues.title: The decision is recorded
cues.note: [Let the named approval land.]

cues.title: Watch
cues.note: It watches, then returns the result. [Time-compressed simulation.]

cues.title: Report
cues.note: Results and exceptions reach the responsible team.

cues.title: Thanks
cues.note: Fresh data. A thank-you. The loop closes where it started.

cues.title: One care loop
cues.note: Emotional connection. Intelligent coordination. Physical help. One care loop.

cues.title: For the people
cues.note: We take care of the machine.

cues.title: Who care
cues.note: You take care of the patient. [Hold. End.]
